news.title: Victim dies in Riverdale shooting, suspect in custody

news.title: Man killed, person in custody after shooting in Riverdale, police say
news.summary: A man is dead, and a person is in custody after a shooting in Riverdale on Friday night, according to the Clayton County Police Department.

news.title: Traffic stop turns into chase in Sandy Springs
news.summary: A traffic stop ended with a chase and the arrest of a driver, according to police.

news.summary: Police have released video showing the arrest of a man accused of stealing copper wire from a southwest Atlanta home.

news.title: Woman dies after running into traffic during fight on I-85
news.summary: A 26-year-old woman was killed after she was hit by a vehicle on Interstate 85 Saturday morning, according to police.

news.title: Man hospitalized after Southwest Atlanta shooting, police say
news.summary: A 36-year-old man is in stable condition after being shot during a verbal dispute in Southwest Atlanta, according to Atlanta Police. The investigation is ongoing.

news.title: Man hospitalized after shooting on Kings Grant Drive in Northwest Atlanta
news.summary: A 20-year-old man is hospitalized in stable condition after being shot in Northwest Atlanta. Police are investigating the incident on Kings Grant Drive.

news.title: Man hospitalized after shooting on Cheshire Bridge Rd in Northeast Atlanta
news.summary: A 35-year-old man is hospitalized after a shooting on Cheshire Bridge Rd NE in Atlanta, reportedly following a verbal dispute with a known suspect, police say.

news.title: Tiny fawn gets a big rescue from Roswell firefighters
news.summary: The fawn was trapped and injured in a stormwater retention area in Roswell.

news.title: Man sentenced for shooting Riverdale resident 13 times, prosecutors say
news.summary: A man was sentenced to life in prison after he was convicted of watching a man's Riverdale apartment for hours before shooting him 13 times, ultimately killing him.
